option.name: --across
tip: Process each input as a whole rather than line by line.
This allows patterns to match across line boundaries but uses more memory and prevents streaming.

option.name: --fixed-strings
tip: Treat FIND and REPLACE_WITH args as literal strings.
Without this, sd treats FIND as a regular expression.

option.name: --flags
tip: Regex flags. May be combined (like `-f mc`).

option.name: --max-replacements
tip: Limit the number of replacements that can occur per file. 0 indicates unlimited replacements [default: 0]

option.name: --preview
tip: Display changes in a human reviewable format.
The specifics of the format are likely to change in the future.
